answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities harvesting work. A slot is a wharf where work docks for inspection, not a haven for idle identities; claiming one costs 10 units. A jury reviews the work: honest output frees deposit plus fee, fake work burns its deposit. Making 100 fakes costs 1,000 units, 10 lost per fake, so cost grows linearly. An honest agent pays one deposit, recovers it, and keeps the fee, like a lotus rising from mud.
